claim_boundary: This gate-only audit-corrected V3 configuration is the sole executable L2b protocol. It preserves every scientific threshold, seed, training budget, reward, observation, contact, friction and energy definition from V2, but no V1 or V2 weights or metrics are reused. The 135-dimensional source already contains the 13-dimensional local-terrain preview. The run cannot establish robustness, random-map generalisation, turning competence, fixed-map reachability, path optimality, electrical-energy improvement or promotion. Failure hard-stops further contact-budget extension and routes the project to a separately predeclared redesign of terrain-feature utilisation and the terrain-normal/downhill controller, with reward held fixed initially.
